Hi Ellen —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the callout on priority rows. Below are short, actionable answers for the items you flagged. I’ve attached a one-page FAQ that summarizes our Hosted API data lifecycle for operational reviewers.

1) Per-tenant erasure (customer-requested deletion)
- Yes. Hosted API supports customer-initiated erasure requests. For API-based data (prompts, responses, metadata) we support deletion requests scoped to a tenant identifier; deletion is executed against active storage and the primary tenant index.
- Typical completion window: 24–72 hours for standard requests. We offer an accelerated purge service for enterprise customers (contract add-on) with a target completion of 8–24 hours depending on data volume and index compaction.

2) Region residency and subprocessors
- For Hosted API, data is stored in the cloud region(s) you select during onboarding (we currently support us-west, us-east, eu-west regions). For Greenline (US region request) we can provision the tenant in us-west or us-east; data will not be replicated to EU regions by default.
- Subprocessors: our primary cloud storage and logging providers are listed in our SSP (internal doc). We restrict cross-region replication and only use subprocessors that contractually agree to Redwood’s data handling terms. A full subprocessors list can be provided under NDA.

3) Logs, caches, and telemetry retention
- Short-term request caches / KV entries: ephemeral and automatically evicted based on TTL (default: 6 hours). This is configurable per-tenant in our Dedicated offering; Hosted API offers conservative defaults to preserve latency benefits.
- Service logs (control plane): retained for 90 days for operational troubleshooting. Audit logs relevant to security events are retained for 1 year (longer retention available as add-on).

Notes and next steps
- We do not ingest or index customer data for model training without explicit, opt-in contractual agreement.
- If you need evidence artifacts (architecture diagram, subprocessors list, SOC2 artifact pointers) I can attach or provide a secure link.

I’ve attached the HostedAPI_Data_Lifecycle_FAQ.pdf — it answers a few of the spreadsheet rows verbatim. Let me know if you want us to map answers directly into your spreadsheet (we can return a completed version).

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
